a: Pi is the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter, about 3.14159. It is irrational, so its digits never end or repeat.
more: Circumference = 2 x pi x r.

a: Algebra uses letters for unknown numbers so you can solve problems. If x + 3 = 10, then x = 7. The rule is to do the same thing to both sides of the equation.
more: Always check by plugging your answer back in.

a: Geometry is the math of shapes, sizes and space: lines, angles, triangles, circles and solids.
more: Key facts: triangle angles add to 180 degrees, a rectangle has 4 right angles.

a: Trigonometry connects angles and sides of right triangles. SOH CAH TOA: sin = opposite/hypotenuse, cos = adjacent/hypotenuse, tan = opposite/adjacent.
more: Used in games, engineering, music and navigation.

a: Calculus is the math of change. Derivatives tell you how fast something changes at a moment (slope). Integrals add up tiny pieces to find totals like area.
more: They are opposites, connected by the fundamental theorem of calculus.

a: An integral adds up infinitely many tiny pieces. It gives the area under a curve. For example the integral of x from 0 to 2 is 2.
more: The integral of x^n is x^(n+1)/(n+1).

a: A matrix is a grid of numbers in rows and columns. You can add them, multiply them, and use them to transform points. They power 3D graphics and neural networks.
more: Matrix multiplication is not commutative, A x B is not B x A.

a: Mean is the average (add all, divide by how many). Median is the middle value when sorted. Mode is the most frequent value.
more: Median is better than mean when there are extreme outliers.

a: Standard deviation measures how spread out numbers are around the average. A small value means they are close together, a large one means very spread out.
more: In a normal distribution about 68% of values fall within one standard deviation.

q: how do i find a percent
a: Percent of a number: multiply the number by the percent and divide by 100. 20% of 80 = 80 x 20 / 100 = 16. To get what percent a is of b: a / b x 100.
more: Percent change = (new - old) / old x 100.

a: A ratio compares two amounts, like 2:3. A proportion says two ratios are equal. If 2 pencils cost $1, then 6 cost $3.
more: Cross multiply to solve proportions.

a: An exponent says how many times to multiply a number by itself: 2^3 = 2 x 2 x 2 = 8. Rules: a^m x a^n = a^(m+n), a^0 = 1, a^-n = 1/a^n.
more: Squared means ^2, cubed means ^3.

a: A logarithm answers: what power gives this number? log base 10 of 1000 is 3 because 10^3 = 1000. It is the inverse of exponents.
more: Used for the Richter scale, decibels and pH.

a: The square root of a number is the value that times itself gives that number. The square root of 49 is 7 because 7 x 7 = 49.
more: Square roots of non-perfect squares like 2 are irrational.

a: Infinity is not a number but the idea of something without end. Some infinities are larger than others, for example there are more real numbers than whole numbers.
more: Mathematicians use it carefully with limits.

a: Even numbers divide by 2 with nothing left over (2, 4, 6...). Odd numbers leave 1 (1, 3, 5...). Zero is even.
more: Even + even = even, odd + odd = even, even + odd = odd.

a: GCF is the largest number that divides both numbers, LCM is the smallest number both divide into. For 12 and 18, GCF = 6 and LCM = 36.
more: Tip: GCF x LCM = product of the two numbers.

a: Do math in this order: Parentheses, Exponents, Multiplication and Division (left to right), then Addition and Subtraction (left to right). So 2 + 3 x 4 = 14, not 20.
more: Ask me any expression and I will calculate it.

a: Get x alone by undoing operations in reverse order and doing the same to both sides. For 2x + 6 = 14: subtract 6 to get 2x = 8, then divide by 2 to get x = 4.
more: Check your answer in the original equation.

a: Rectangle: width x height. Triangle: half x base x height. Circle: pi x r². Trapezoid: half x (a + b) x height.
more: Area is measured in square units.

a: Sphere: 4/3 x pi x r³. Cylinder: pi x r² x h. Cone: 1/3 x pi x r² x h. Box: length x width x height.
more: Volume is measured in cubic units.

a: Perimeter is the distance around a shape, so you add all the sides. For a circle it is called circumference: 2 x pi x r.
more: A rectangle's perimeter is 2 x (length + width).

a: Slope tells how steep a line is: rise over run = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1). A line is written y = mx + b, where m is the slope and b is where it crosses the y-axis.
more: Positive slope goes up, negative goes down.

a: The angles in a triangle add up to 180 degrees. Acute is under 90, right is exactly 90, obtuse is between 90 and 180, straight is 180.
more: A quadrilateral adds to 360.

a: Prime factorization breaks a number into prime numbers multiplied together. 60 = 2 x 2 x 3 x 5. Divide by the smallest prime repeatedly until you reach 1.
more: Every whole number above 1 has exactly one prime factorization.

a: The Fibonacci sequence starts 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13... each number is the sum of the previous two. Ratios of neighbors approach the golden ratio, about 1.618.
more: It appears in spirals, flowers and shells.

a: A vector has both size and direction, like velocity (60 km/h north). Scalars like temperature have only size. Vectors add tip to tail.
more: Used in physics, games and machine learning.

a: Compound interest earns interest on your interest. A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt). $1,000 at 5% for 10 years grows to about $1,629. The longer you wait the faster it grows.
more: It works against you on debt too.

a: A set is a collection of distinct things. Union combines sets, intersection is what they share. Venn diagrams draw the overlap with circles.
more: Programming sets (in Python or JS) work the same way.

q: what is a function in math
a: A math function is a rule that gives exactly one output for each input. f(x) = 2x + 1 means plug in x and get 2x + 1, so f(3) = 7.
more: The graph passes the vertical line test.

a: Zero is the number for nothing and a placeholder in our number system. Indian mathematicians developed it as a true number around the 5th to 7th century.
more: Without zero, big numbers and computers would be very hard.
